item.title: 🟠 COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw likely linked to $88 million Bitcoin theft
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A vulnerability in COLDCARD hardware wallet firmware allowed attackers to steal an estimated $88.6 million in Bitcoin from thousands of wallets whose seeds were generated using a flawed random number generator. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1h ago
